headers.name: x-volterra-location
headers.source: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/multi-cloud-app-connect/how-to/adv-security/configure-http-header-processing (the optional Add Location setting of an HTTP load balancer adds x-volterra-location to the responses, its value naming the Regional Edge site), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.f5.com, www.nginx.com and www.shapesecurity.com (pa4-par)

server.source: https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/multi-cloud-app-connect/how-to/adv-security/manipulate-server-header-in-https-response (the HTTP load balancer responds with the server value volt-adc by default), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.f5.com, www.nginx.com, account.f5.com and www.shapesecurity.com

https://community.f5.com/kb/technicalarticles/use-f5-distributed-cloud-to-service-chain-waap-and-cdn/303142 (F5 DevCentral, 2022: a response served through the Distributed Cloud CDN carries server: volt-cdn). Not observed

cname.source: https://github.com/f5devcentral/xcwaapdemoguide (F5's demo guide: the host auto-generated for an HTTP load balancer ends in .ac.vh.ves.io), and observed on 2026-11-16 on www.f5.com, www.nginx.com and account.f5.com (ves-io-<uuid>.ac.vh.ves.io), as the last name of the chain
